summary:
Implemented terminal window title support in the Rich repository, without running tests or committing.

Changes:
- rich/segment.py: added ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16.
- rich/control.py: added the format entry emitting OSC 0 (\x1b]0;{title}\x07) and a Control.title(title) classmethod with a docstring noting terminal support and that the title is not reset on exit.
- rich/console.py: added Console.set_window_title(title), which sends Control.title(title) via self.control.
- tests/test_control.py: added test_control_title checking the emitted string and segment.
- CHANGELOG.md: added an "Added" entry under Unreleased.

Not done: the title is not sanitized, so characters such as \x07 or \x1b in the title would terminate the OSC sequence early. Tests were not run.
